hard_gates: Weights must be derived from one declared energy/free-energy convention and sum to one.
The density artifact must be relaxed_mp2 from the selected production method.
Every surface must be linked to its wavefunction and conformer.
The ensemble must include a truncation-sensitivity estimate.
paper_scope_note: This scoped subset tests conformer sensitivity. It must not claim to recalibrate the paper-wide density cutoff.
